title: Austin's Strategic Planning Session
summary:
*   City officials held a work session focused entirely on developing a "Six Month Work Plan," outlining key strategic initiatives for the city's future.
*   This special meeting prioritized strategic planning, with no executive sessions or appointments to city boards and commissions.
*   The session took place at the Central Library's Council Chambers and concluded in under two hours.
